cover.title: the founder who sees ai traffic first

inner.title: the ai floor
inner.body: ga4 added an ai assistant channel on may 13, 2026, tagging chatgpt, gemini and claude visits. it only counts visits with a referrer, so it's a floor.
inner.label: undercounted

inner.title: ai hiding in direct
inner.body: visits without a referrer, like links opened in in-app browsers, get filed under direct. one dataset found 70.6% of identified ai visits had no referrer.
inner.label: 70.6% invisible

inner.title: the referrer vanishes
inner.body: free chat apps often send no referrer, and copied links lose it in a new tab. safari privacy settings strip what remains.
inner.label: gone in safari

inner.title: check perplexity
inner.body: perplexity isn't in google's ai assistant channel, so its visits still land in referral. without a perplexity rule, your ai report skips it.
inner.label: still referral

inner.title: where ai lands
inner.body: assistants cite pages beyond your homepage, so sort referral and direct visits by landing page. llm-referred visitors convert at twice the rate of other sources.
inner.label: 2x conversion

closer.HEADLINE:
it's not missing.
it's misfiled.
